featured_reviews.review_text:
Honestly, one of the worst experiences I’ve had at a stationery store. I went in excited to buy a few things I needed, but the staff made it so uncomfortable. They acted like I was bothering them just by asking questions, and when I asked about a product, they gave short, rude answers like they didn’t care at all. They didn’t even bother to be little bit polite they treated like I was invisible.
I don’t usually complain about service, but basic politeness costs nothing. It’s sad when good products are ruined by bad attitude. Definitely not going back there again.

We have immediately addressed this with our entire team to ensure that everyone understands the importance of respect, attentiveness, and going the extra mile for our customers, regardless of what they are asking for.

We value your business and hope that you would consider giving us another chance in the future.

Sincerely,

Aashish Gala
Anupam Stationery Point
